column3: “purifying water” renders “water of sin offering,” and “let them use a razor” renders “let them make a razor pass.”
“a bull” renders “a young bull, a son of the herd” (twice).
“present … as a wave offering” renders “wave … as a wave offering” (also in verses 13, 15 and 21), and “that they may qualify to perform” renders “that they may be to serve.”
“purified themselves from sin” renders a single verb, “de-sinned themselves.”
